as_told.title: Gene Huff's view of Lazar approaching Dennis at the casino

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft at a secret site in Nevada in the late 1980s, tells Michels about his last meeting with a man named Dennis Mariani in a Las Vegas casino in 1989. Lazar says he walked up and kept saying, 'Dennis, I'm here, what do you want? What's going on?', but Mariani never even looked up at him. Lazar went over to his friend Gene Huff, said he did not know what was going on with Dennis, and when the two of them turned around, Mariani was gone. The researcher Luigi Vendittelli tells the same scene as Huff told it to him, and describes Mariani as a blond, military-looking man who would not look at Lazar while Lazar talked. To the tellers it suggests that Mariani came to watch or warn rather than to talk. Lazar was there, and Vendittelli repeats what the other man who was there told him.
